title: Fleetwood knock the champions out of the Carabao Cup on penalties
summary: Fleetwood Town, 84 places below Arsenal in the pyramid and in the bottom half of League Two, knocked the Premier League champions out of the Carabao Cup, winning 5-3 on penalties after a 1-1 draw at Highbury Stadium. Aaron Loupalo-Bi scored in the 21st minute, Viktor Gyokeres equalised after the break, and Arsenal's 16-year-old Max Dowman was sent off before Jay Lynch saved Bruno Guimaraes' kick and Conor Haughey converted the winner. Mikel Arteta called it a very sad day.
